name: Example: API Call with Self-Healing
description: Shows how to wrap a scheduled API call with the self-healing pattern. Replace the URL with your real endpoint.
author: Rana Ahmad — github.com/Ranahmad1
usage: Import into n8n alongside self_healing_workflow.json. Replace the HTTP Request URL with your real API.
pattern: continueOnFail → Error Check → Error Catcher pipeline

nodes.name: Schedule Trigger (every 15 min)
nodes.note: Fires every 15 minutes. Change to your desired schedule.

nodes.name: Fetch Data from API
nodes.note: continueOnFail: true is CRITICAL — without it, errors halt execution before reaching the recovery pipeline.

nodes.name: → Connect output to Error Check node in self_healing_workflow
nodes.note: The Error Check node reads $json.error and $json.statusCode to decide if recovery is needed.

expected_recovery_behavior.401: Immediately escalates to human — no auto-retry
expected_recovery_behavior.404: Logs the missing resource and skips
